bio.text: Jeremy Todd, a Libertarian and Northern Kentucky resident, is a candidate for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to LINK nky, the nomination petition, with more than 750 signatures, was submitted to the Kentucky Secretary of State's office on June 2, 2026, after Rep. Thomas Massie lost the Republican primary to Ed Gallrein.

sources.title: Libertarian secures ballot access in Kentucky's 4th Congressional District
